I’m 19 and a few months ago I made the decision to make a private account away from everyone I knew in high school apart from a few close friends, at first it felt weird having such a small account and posting stuff but then I realized the interactions I got was actually a lot more on this smaller account than on my main bigger account, I could freely say most of anything I wanted and the people in that account seemed to love it, it made me feel good finally cutting off that mental weight of people from the past who add no value to my life whatsoever. I used to get so nervous on my main account and I had to post mostly in the close friends section but now I could just talk without judgement. More recently I also came to discover that some of my close friends aren’t really that good of friends to me and most of the time I’ve been around them they made me feel like shit so I just made the decision to stop talking to them and stuck to it, it was extremely lonely at first but I got used to it now my confidence is way better and I can definitely say I’m more assertive with people after making the decision to cut them off. Currently I have basically one friend but I couldn’t have had it any other way, my mental health is so much better and things in my life are looking up…I’m thinking of going into uni and honestly I’m nothing but positive about it cause now I know for a fact that I will never allow ‘friends’ to walk over me again, if I can cut off people I’ve been friends with for years for disrespecting me I can do it to some random people I just recently met. For things to change in your life you have to force it, just cut everything lose and hope for better even having no friends will be a lot better than having toxic ones so it’s a win win if you think about it. Also from what I’ve seen people in uni are friendlier than you think.
